subject: Excess usage mediation + contract amendment for capacity top‑up
messages:
From: Samira Khan <samira.khan@olivetech.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected spike in inference hours — request to reconcile and amend term

Hi Evelyn,

We just closed our monthly reconciliation and discovered ~1.2M inference hours billed for May (our committed capacity was 350k hours). This created a large one‑time overage we weren't expecting.

Can Redwood help us understand the reconciliation and propose an amendment path? Ideally we want: a) a clear line item settlement for the May overage, b) a short‑term capacity top‑up to cover the June spike, and c) an addendum to the contract to increase committed capacity for Q3.

I attached a summary export from our usage dashboard — happy to jump on a call this week. Procurement is looped for PO/invoice questions.

Thanks,
Samira Khan
Head of Cloud Ops, OliveTech
(samira.khan@olivetech.com)

Attachment: OliveTech_overage_summary_Jun2027.pdf
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@olivetech.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>
Date: Fri, 18 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in inference hours — request to reconcile and amend term

Hi Samira — thanks for sending this and for the summary. I reviewed the usage export and I can see the burst pattern that caused the overage.

Proposal (short/medium term):
- May overage: propose a split settlement — one third (33%) as a one‑time credit, one third amortized across the next two invoices, and one third invoice as a payable one‑time charge; this reduces immediate cash impact while closing the month.
- June top‑up: immediate short‑term capacity purchase (additional 250k hours available through 8/31) at a discounted uplift rate.
- Contract addendum: prepare a Q3 committed increase to 600k/mo (three‑month pilot), with an option to convert to an annual commit at the end of the pilot.

I'll draft an amendment and a settlement invoice plan and loop finance/legal for the specifics. Marissa — can you take the redline for the amendment? Ben — can you prep the invoice splits and payment terms (PO friendly)?

If that sounds OK, let's schedule a 30m call Monday to finalize.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
E: evelyn.hart@redwood.com | M: +1 415 555 0188
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Samira Khan <samira.khan@olivetech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, procurement <procurement@olivetech.com>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in inference hours — request to reconcile and amend term

Hi all — reviewed Evelyn's proposal and attached a redline of the amendment with the commit change and the temporary pilot clause. Key notes:
- We will mark the May overage as Invoice #INV‑2027‑1628 (one‑time charge) and create two credit memos totaling 33% of the overage to be applied to INV‑2027‑1702 and INV‑2027‑1703.
- The short‑term top‑up will be issued as a separate SKU so it is clearly delineated on OliveTech's PO.
- Legal requests a 45‑day cure period for any disputes and a mutual data sampling clause for usage verification.

Samira — if you can confirm procurement's PO cadence and whether OliveTech requires a single consolidated invoice or split invoices for the amortized credits, I can finalize the doc and send to DocuSign.

Attachment: RDW_Amendment_Redline_v3.docx

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Contracts | Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira.khan@olivetech.com>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2027 10:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike in inference hours — request to reconcile and amend term

Quick follow up with finance numbers so procurement can plan:
- May overage total: $184,500
  - One‑time immediate invoice (INV‑2027‑1628): $61,500
  - Two credit memos (CM‑2027‑09, CM‑2027‑10): $61,500 applied across July/August invoices
- Short‑term 250k hour top‑up (Jun 18–Aug 31) at discounted rate: $37,500 (separate line item on PO)
- Amendment setup fee (one‑time): $2,500 (waivable if OliveTech converts to annual commit by Sept 30)

Samira/procurement — confirm whether we should issue a single consolidated invoice or the split approach above. I can generate the invoice package once you confirm the PO number.

Thanks — I added the DocuSign envelope link here for signature routing: https://www.docusign.com/some-envelope-id-8347

Ben Carter
Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
